# Error Codes

The server error-code registry, `ERROR_REGISTRY` in `src/code_indexer/server/error_codes.py`, defines 911 codes across 15 subsystems: 104 have a description and 807 do not yet. Each subsystem has its own page.

## Format

A code has the form `SUBSYSTEM-CATEGORY-NUMBER`: SUBSYSTEM is 2-6 uppercase letters naming the functional area, CATEGORY is 2-8 uppercase letters naming the component or operation, and NUMBER is three digits (checked by `validate_error_code_format`). Example: `APP-GENERAL-001`.

7 registered codes do not follow this format: `GIT-FILE-HISTORY-003`, `MONITOR-GENERAL-001`, `MONITOR-GENERAL-002`, `MONITOR-GENERAL-003`, `MONITOR-GENERAL-004`, `MONITOR-GENERAL-005`, `MONITOR-GENERAL-006`.

## How the registry is used

The registry is a catalogue. Each log call site writes its code into the message itself through `format_error_log(code, message, ...)` in `src/code_indexer/server/logging_utils.py`, which produces `[CODE] message key=value`. Nothing looks a code up in the registry at runtime, so the description and suggested action on the subsystem pages document a code; they are not the text of the log line. To find occurrences, search the logs for the code in square brackets.
